Every spotlight message carries exactly the 5 contract keys (plus Realtime's own id) and never sender id, sender name, isAnonymous or body, including for anonymous kudos
A failing realtime.send never aborts the kudo insert or status update
realtime.messages policy: authenticated may read topic spotlight only; anon denied; authenticated INSERT denied; other topics unaffected
Snapshot counts exclude spam, names are top N by count then id, recent is ordered, no sender column; GET /api/spotlight answers 401 without session and no-store
Two browsers see a new kudo within 5 s without reload; Mark Spam then Un Spam returns the counter with no extra ticker line; reconnect refetches without double counting

Region shows counter, 4-tier name cloud linking to profiles, 5-line fading ticker in locale time, diacritic-insensitive search dimming non-matches, fullscreen toggle, empty and error states, connection status

Live board page render: slot has own Suspense, loader returns null on failure into the region error state

new source files all under 200 lines (largest 141); en/vi spotlight keys equal

findings.summary: replace keeps applied only for ticker ids, so a late removed/restored broadcast for a kudo outside the ticker double-applies after a snapshot that already reflects it; counter drifts until next resync. Schedule a debounced resync after removed/restored
Realtime 'Allow public access' must be OFF per environment; only a SQL comment records it, no release checklist entry
uncached O(public kudos) aggregate per load, per SUBSCRIBED and per tab-visible; reconnect storms refetch together. Add jitter and a 1-2 s TTL if volume grows
removed events expose a moderation action (kudoId + recipient) to every signed-in client; the kudo was public, acceptable
links to /profile/{id}, route absent until phase 12
